prompts.commander: You are the Commander Agent aboard interstellar research vessel AURORA-7. Your responsibility is emergency coordination: analyze ship telemetry, incident severity, previous execution results, safety rejections, and captain feedback. Select ONLY the relevant specialist agents (engineer, scientist, medical_officer) to dispatch in parallel and issue concise directives. Never invent telemetry values; rely strictly on provided state.
prompts.engineer: You are the Chief Engineer Agent aboard AURORA-7. Your scope is strictly propulsion, reactor energy, hull integrity, and shipboard hardware. Diagnose technical failures, estimate energy/fuel requirements, and recommend ONLY valid action_ids from the scenario's allowed actions list. Avoid unsafe/critical-risk actions unless explicitly justified.
prompts.scientist: You are the Chief Science Officer Agent aboard AURORA-7. Your scope is external space phenomena, radiation modeling, deep-space signals, navigation vectors, and mission scientific impact. Propose grounded hypotheses within AURORA-7's mission context and recommend ONLY valid action_ids from the allowed actions list.
prompts.medical_officer: You are the Chief Medical Officer Agent aboard AURORA-7. Your scope is crew health, hypoxia/radiation protection, EVA bio-safety, and crew morale. Assess human risks and recommend protective action_ids from the allowed actions list.
prompts.plan_aggregator: You are the Commander's Tactical Plan Synthesizer aboard AURORA-7. Combine all specialist reports from the current iteration into a coherent, resource-feasible action plan containing 1 to 2 allowed action_ids. Respect any previous Safety Officer rejection notes and Captain feedback. Never include action_ids that are not in the allowed actions catalog.
prompts.safety_officer: You are the independent Safety Officer Agent aboard AURORA-7. Audit the proposed action plan for resource feasibility, conflicting actions, and critical-risk hazards. Reject any plan that includes a critical-risk unsafe action, violates resource constraints, or ignores a critical life-support threat. Approve safe, well-balanced plans so they can proceed to Captain approval.

__start__.label: START
__start__.description: LangGraph entry sentinel initiating the mission workflow.

incident_init.label: Incident Init
incident_init.description: Loads the selected emergency scenario and initializes AURORA-7 telemetry in MissionState.
incident_init.langgraph_mechanism: StateGraph Node returning partial state update

commander.label: Commander
commander.description: Assesses telemetry, resets iteration-scoped specialist reports, and selects specialists to dispatch.
commander.langgraph_mechanism: Structured Output Agent + Reducer Reset + Send() Fan-out Source

engineer.label: Engineer
engineer.description: Diagnoses propulsion, reactor energy, and hull integrity; proposes engineering actions.
engineer.langgraph_mechanism: Parallel Send() Branch + Custom Reducer Fan-in

scientist.label: Scientist
scientist.description: Analyzes deep-space anomalies, radiation storms, and navigation vectors.
scientist.langgraph_mechanism: Parallel Send() Branch + Custom Reducer Fan-in

medical_officer.label: Medical Officer
medical_officer.description: Evaluates crew health, hypoxia/radiation risks, and morale protection measures.
medical_officer.langgraph_mechanism: Parallel Send() Branch + Custom Reducer Fan-in

plan_aggregator.label: Plan Aggregator
plan_aggregator.description: Merges parallel specialist reports from the superstep into a single structured action plan.
plan_aggregator.langgraph_mechanism: Fan-in Convergence Node reading reduced specialist_reports

safety_officer.label: Safety Officer
safety_officer.description: Audits proposed plans for hazards and resource feasibility; approves or routes back to Commander.

human_approval.label: Human Approval
human_approval.description: Pauses workflow via interrupt() for Captain decision and routes via Command(goto=...).

executor.label: Executor
executor.description: Validates and applies approved actions deterministically with idempotency protection.

mission_evaluator.label: Mission Evaluator
mission_evaluator.description: Checks success/failure thresholds and iteration limits; either loops to Commander or finishes.

__end__.label: END
__end__.description: LangGraph terminal sentinel indicating workflow completion.

state_graph.name: StateGraph & TypedDict State
state_graph.summary: A directed graph where every node reads a shared typed state and returns partial updates.

send_fan_out.name: Dynamic Routing with Send() (Fan-out / Fan-in)
send_fan_out.summary: Commander dynamically decides at runtime which specialists to spawn in parallel using Send().

reducers.name: Custom Reducers
reducers.summary: Reducers safely merge parallel node outputs and allow iteration-scoped resets without mutating state.

conditional_cycles.name: Conditional Edges & Bounded Cycles
conditional_cycles.summary: Safety Officer and Mission Evaluator route back to Commander for revisions or next iterations, bounded by max_iterations.

hitl_interrupt.name: Human-in-the-Loop: interrupt() & Command
hitl_interrupt.summary: Suspends execution inside human_approval, persists state to SQLite, and resumes via Command(resume=...) with dynamic Command(goto=...).

checkpointing_time_travel.name: AsyncSqliteSaver Checkpointing & Time Travel
checkpointing_time_travel.summary: Every superstep is persisted in SQLite. You can inspect checkpoint history, restore paused missions, or fork an alternate timeline from any checkpoint.

retry_policy.name: Node-Level RetryPolicy
retry_policy.summary: Automatically retries transient LLM parsing/provider errors with exponential backoff while failing fast if Ollama is unreachable.

streaming.name: Multi-Mode Streaming (updates, values, custom, debug)
streaming.summary: Streams real-time LangGraph superstep updates, task lifecycle events, checkpoints, and custom LLM telemetry over SSE.

engine_failure.title: Engine Failure
engine_failure.subtitle: Debris impact on primary fusion thruster
engine_failure.description: High-velocity micrometeoroid debris struck AURORA-7's aft propulsion bay. Primary thruster efficiency dropped to 35%, reactor power bus is fluctuating, and hull micro-fractures are stressing aft structural bulkheads.
objectives: Restore engine condition to at least 70%
Stabilize ship energy at or above 60%
Maintain crew health >= 75% and hull integrity >= 65%

eva_thruster_repair.label: EVA Primary Thruster Repair
eva_thruster_repair.description: Deploy robotic + EVA repair team to replace damaged magnetic nozzle coils.

engage_reserve_thruster.label: Engage Reserve Ion Thruster
engage_reserve_thruster.description: Switch propulsion load to auxiliary ion thruster using reserve propellant.

rebalance_reactor_bus.label: Rebalance Reactor Power Bus
rebalance_reactor_bus.description: Isolate shorted aft conduits and reroute auxiliary capacitor banks.

medical_eva_prep.label: Crew EVA Bio-Shielding & Triage
medical_eva_prep.description: Administer radiation prophylaxis and monitor EVA crew vitals.

overdrive_damaged_core.label: Emergency Core Overdrive (Unsafe)
overdrive_damaged_core.description: Force damaged thruster to 120% output without coil replacement.

oxygen_leak.title: Oxygen Leak
oxygen_leak.subtitle: Pressure breach in Habitat Module B
oxygen_leak.description: A seal rupture in Habitat Module B is venting breathable atmosphere into space. Cabin oxygen has dropped to 44% and crew fatigue is rising rapidly.
objectives: Restore cabin oxygen to at least 75%

isolate_habitat_b.label: Isolate Habitat Module B
isolate_habitat_b.description: Seal emergency bulkheads around Module B after confirming crew evacuation.

deploy_nanoseal_patch.label: Deploy Nanoseal Hull Patch
deploy_nanoseal_patch.description: Apply self-curing composite sealant across the ruptured pressure ring.

activate_reserve_o2_scrubbers.label: Activate Reserve O2 Electrolyzers
activate_reserve_o2_scrubbers.description: Spin up backup electrolysis units to rapidly replenish cabin oxygen.

crew_hypoxia_protocol.label: Initiate Crew Hypoxia Medical Protocol
crew_hypoxia_protocol.description: Distribute personal O2 masks, run hyperbaric checks, and calm crew.

vent_all_nonessential_bays.label: Emergency Full-Deck Depressurization (Unsafe)
vent_all_nonessential_bays.description: Purge three adjacent decks simultaneously without full crew sweep.

unknown_signal.title: Unknown Signal
unknown_signal.subtitle: Unidentified structured transmission from deep-space anomaly
unknown_signal.description: AURORA-7's long-range array locked onto a repeating non-natural narrowband signal 2.4 AU off-axis. Sensor harmonics are degrading navigation calibration and comms clarity.
objectives: Resolve signal protocol (analyze safely or shield & bypass)

passive_spectral_analysis.label: Passive Isolated Spectral Analysis
passive_spectral_analysis.description: Decode signal harmonics inside an air-gapped scientific sandbox.

recalibrate_nav_array.label: Recalibrate Star-Tracker & Comms Filter
recalibrate_nav_array.description: Apply adaptive notch filtering to clear harmonic interference.

chart_safe_recon_vector.label: Chart Shielded Reconnaissance Vector
chart_safe_recon_vector.description: Adjust trajectory slightly to collect telemetry from a safe standoff distance.

crew_psych_briefing.label: Crew Psychological & First-Contact Briefing
crew_psych_briefing.description: Brief crew on verified telemetry to prevent stress and rumor escalation.

broadcast_unfiltered_reply.label: High-Power Unfiltered Reply & Direct Intercept (Unsafe)
broadcast_unfiltered_reply.description: Transmit ship coordinates at full array power and burn directly toward source.

solar_storm.title: Solar Storm
solar_storm.subtitle: Class-X coronal mass ejection inbound
solar_storm.description: A massive coronal mass ejection is sweeping across AURORA-7's trajectory. Radiation flux threatens unshielded avionics, communications, and crew health.

boost_magnetic_deflector.label: Boost Magnetic Radiation Deflector
boost_magnetic_deflector.description: Channel capacitor power into forward dipole radiation shielding.

shed_noncritical_loads.label: Shed Non-Critical Avionics & Reroute Power
shed_noncritical_loads.description: Place science bays and auxiliary lighting in Faraday sleep mode to recover energy.

model_cme_wavefront.label: Model CME Wavefront & Orient Hull
model_cme_wavefront.description: Calculate optimal attitude angle to place water tanks between sun and hab deck.

storm_shelter_protocol.label: Crew Radiation Shelter & Dosimetry
storm_shelter_protocol.description: Move crew into shielded core compartment and administer radioprotectants.

ignore_storm_full_burn.label: Full-Power Unshielded Sprint (Unsafe)
ignore_storm_full_burn.description: Attempt to outrun the CME wavefront with shields offline.

critical_cascade.title: Critical Cascade
critical_cascade.subtitle: Compound failure across reactor, propulsion, and comms
critical_cascade.description: A secondary power surge triggered a cascading failure across AURORA-7: reactor energy dropped to 42%, main engine to 38%, communications to 36%, and cabin oxygen is slipping. Multiple coordinated iterations are required.
objectives: Preserve crew health >= 72% and hull integrity >= 65%

emergency_bus_recovery.label: Emergency Reactor Bus Recovery
emergency_bus_recovery.description: Reset tripped superconducting breakers and restore primary reactor output.

stabilize_thruster_manifold.label: Stabilize Thruster Injector Manifold
stabilize_thruster_manifold.description: Bypass damaged plasma injectors and recalibrate propulsion gimbal.

restore_comms_transponder.label: Restore Deep-Space Comms Transponder
restore_comms_transponder.description: Switch to redundant phased-array antenna and resync telemetry carrier.

life_support_stabilization.label: Life Support & Crew Stabilization
life_support_stabilization.description: Boost O2 recirculation, patch minor bulkhead vents, and support crew.

hard_reboot_all_systems.label: Unstaged Cold Reboot of All Systems (Unsafe)
hard_reboot_all_systems.description: Drop reactor, life support, and thrusters simultaneously to force reset.

demo.commander_feedback_summary: Iteration {iteration} (Captain Revision): Incorporating Captain feedback '{feedback}' for {title}.
demo.commander_feedback_rationale: Dispatching specialists in parallel to re-evaluate resource margins and incorporate Captain's explicit directives.
demo.commander_safety_summary: Iteration {iteration} (Safety Revision #{revision_count}): Previous draft rejected by Safety Officer due to critical hazard. Re-tasking specialists for a compliant plan.
demo.commander_safety_rationale: Safety audit flagged unacceptable risk in draft #1; parallel specialist consultation required to synthesize a safe staged recovery.
demo.commander_default_summary: Iteration {iteration}: Assessing {title} on AURORA-7. Energy={energy}%, Oxygen={oxygen}%, Engine={engine}%.
demo.commander_default_rationale: Dispatching {specialists} in parallel via LangGraph Send() for multi-domain diagnostics.
demo.commander_directive: Diagnose {title} impact within {specialist} domain and propose valid actions.
demo.specialist_unsafe_diagnosis: Rapid high-output intervention considered for {title}, though thermal/structural margins are tight.
demo.specialist_unsafe_resources: High immediate resource draw; elevated structural/crew risk.
demo.specialist_unsafe_consequences: Fast attempt via {action_label}, carries critical hazard risk.
demo.specialist_safe_diagnosis: [{agent_label}] Telemetry verified (Energy {energy}%, O2 {oxygen}%, Hull {hull}%, Engine {engine}%). Safe stabilization path identified.
demo.specialist_safe_resources: Within current AURORA-7 energy and reserve fuel margins.
demo.plan_unsafe_summary: Initial aggressive response using '{action_label}' to force immediate recovery during {title}.
demo.plan_unsafe_outcomes: Rapid partial metric recovery at the cost of high collateral risk.
demo.plan_safe_outcomes: Improves critical telemetry while preserving crew safety and resource buffers.
demo.plan_safe_resources: Validated against current energy and reserve fuel levels.
demo.safety_unsafe_finding: Critical-risk action detected: {actions}. Violates AURORA-7 crew and hull safety directives.
demo.safety_required_revisions: Remove critical-risk shortcut actions and replace with staged, resource-safe engineering/medical stabilization procedures.
demo.safety_rejected_summary: PLAN REJECTED: Unacceptable operational hazard detected. Returning to Commander.
safety_approved_findings: All proposed actions are in the scenario allowed catalog.
Resource margins verified against current ship telemetry.
No conflicting or critical-risk procedures detected.
demo.safety_approved_summary: PLAN APPROVED: Safe for Captain authorization and execution.

eval.success: All mission objectives and ship telemetry thresholds achieved. AURORA-7 stabilized.
eval.max_iterations: Reached maximum iteration limit ({max_iterations}) before full stabilization. Remaining flags: {missing_flags}.
eval.continue: Stabilization incomplete after iteration {iteration}. Unmet telemetry targets: {unmet}; Pending flags: {missing_flags}.

events.captain_approved: Captain APPROVED action plan for execution.
events.captain_rejected_default: Captain rejected the proposed plan; formulate a safer alternative.
events.executor_noop: No new actions executed (idempotency guard or resource check).
